question: The Khalji Dynasty ruled over Delhi from ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1290 to 1320.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Khalji Dynasty- was the second ruling family of the Delhi sultanate, a Muslim kingdom in north India.
 
• **The Khalji dynasty ruled from 1290 to 1320.**
 
• It was founded by Jalal ud din Firuz Khalji and came to power in a revolution that signified the transfer of authority from Turkic nobility to Afghans.
 
• Alauddin Khalji made serious efforts to re-assess the land revenue and unify the taxes not only in rural areas but also in urban areas.
 
• He established a centralised administrative system of revenue collection. 
 
• Muqtis were appointed for revenue collection.
 
• Alauddin made sure that their offices were not hereditary.
 
• He kept proper control over them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Khalji Dynasty:

 
 
• Founder: Jalal-ud-din Firoz Khilji
 
• The Khilji dynasty started from 1290 to 1320 AD.
 
• Famous ruler: Ala-ud-din Khilji
 
• Last ruler: Quṭb al-Din Mubarak Shah
